connections.name: Azure Developer CLI
connections.reason: Provision the Automation Account and supporting resources.

connections.name: Azure CLI
connections.reason: Run interactive ARM, Graph, Exchange, Entra role, Azure RBAC, and cleanup hooks. Redeployment can remove an existing Automation Account delete lock and replace all its job schedules. Read checks do not prove authority to make these changes.

groups.title: Maester coverage
groups.description: Choose the services and optional dashboard included by the template.

fields.label: Include secured web dashboard
fields.help: Creates or updates an Entra application and service principal, including tenant-wide delegated Graph consent. Access is restricted to your selected security group.

fields.label: Include Exchange checks
fields.help: Grants Exchange.ManageAsApp and attempts to assign the Exchange View-Only Configuration role.

fields.label: Include Teams checks
fields.help: Assigns the Entra Teams Reader role to the automation identity.

fields.label: Include Azure checks
fields.help: Assigns Azure Reader to the automation identity at each configured scope, or the selected subscription when scopes are blank.

fields.label: Allowed security group
fields.help: Object ID of the Entra security group allowed through App Service Easy Auth.

fields.label: Mail recipient
fields.help: Optional recipient for Maester email notifications. Providing a recipient also grants Microsoft Graph Mail.Send to the automation identity.

fields.label: Permission profile
fields.help: Minimal grants eight baseline Graph application read roles. Extended adds eleven application roles for device, security, SharePoint, and hunting coverage. Review these identity permissions before deployment.

fields.label: Azure RBAC scopes
fields.help: Optional semicolon-separated ARM scope IDs. The selected subscription is used when left blank.

recommendationProfiles.title: Minimal pilot
recommendationProfiles.description: Disables the dashboard, Exchange, Teams, and Azure checks while keeping the Minimal profile's eight baseline managed-identity Graph application read roles. No email recipient is configured.

permissionChecks.name: Directory write authority requires operator review
permissionChecks.description: Directory read access cannot prove authority to assign application permissions, Entra roles, or delegated consent. Review the privileges required by your selected features before running the interactive hooks.

permissionChecks.name: Azure subscription access
permissionChecks.description: Azure CLI can complete a live ARM read of the selected enabled subscription in the selected tenant.

permissionChecks.name: Microsoft Graph directory access
permissionChecks.description: Azure CLI can query Microsoft Graph for the selected tenant before setup hooks run.
